clips.title: The story
paras: Grif Wildheart’s final trial in Kharanos tests a dwarf hunter’s control over a wild bear. You use an enchanted rod to subdue an aggressive Ice Claw Bear and learn to understand it. Passing unlocks the abilities to tame, call, and dismiss a permanent wild companion.

Mountaineers and scouts across Dun Morogh rely on hardy beasts in its freezing crags. After students practice on swift, cunning predators, master huntsman Grif Wildheart sends you to capture an Ice Claw Bear. The bears prowl the snowdrifts east of Kharanos. Their raw strength and endurance test the control every dwarven huntsman must learn.

The Taming Rod trials teach you how wild instincts answer to will and calm intent. The rod holds the bear docile, making your bond temporary and the exercise educational. Return the rod to Grif to complete the formal trials. He then shares the lasting secrets of beast mastery: pacifying a compatible wild creature and calling upon it throughout your life of adventure.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Perhaps you'd like a creature that possesses little more than brute strength. The ice claw bear is an excellent companion for a fledgling adventurer like yourself, and can be found east of Kharanos. Here is the taming rod; try this animal as a pet and see if ya like it!

When you return, I'll give ya the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing; this creature will face the challenges you face, and gain experience alongside you. I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as ya like.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you tamed the ice claw bear yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here you are, friend. I will now give ya the power to tame a beast, as well as call it and dismiss it as you please.
Find yerself a good, loyal pet, and enjoy the hunt!
